attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 27 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and the entry names both saints, so it is one folder each. The page says of her only «Η Αγία Μαρκία μαρτύρησε δια ξίφους». She is not the corpus's Marcia of Caesarea, who is kept on another day. This pair is also the pair saint.gr's asterisked entry for 26 Ιουνίου points to; that entry carries the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence and is refused, while this day's page carries no asterisk and no such sentence.
